title: Invoke AI Agent with Amazon EventBridge Scheduler
description: Create a EventBridge scheduler which invokes an Amazon Bedrock Agent.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates how to invoke an Amazon Bedrock AI Agent on a recurring schedule using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. An orchestrator AWS Lambda function, invoked by the scheduler, sends a task payload to the Amazon Bedrock Agent, which processes the input, generates an execution summary, and persists the result to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The pattern includes retry logic, a dead-letter queue for failed invocations, and least-privilege IAM policies scoped to the agent alias ARN.
